CYBER002.issue: Confirm that changes at the breached site and other reuse sites are independently assessable; do not require every hypothetical account or a named password manager.
Recovery and session revocation are conditional on observed compromise or provider guidance; no proof of compromise is supplied.

CYBER073.issue: Invalidation is mandatory; replacement is conditional on continued service need, not a required new credential when the key is no longer needed.
Check whether coordinated history cleanup is proportionate; do not require destructive force-push or pretend every clone can be erased.

CYBER080.issue: Review whether the proposed isolation boundary provides proportionate compensating protection. Isolation is counted within this operational outcome, avoiding duplicate broad and narrow credit; no second unrelated control is compulsory.
Review migration criticality and ordinal distinction. Accept an accountable migration next step and justified checkpoint; do not demand an invented guaranteed date.

CYBER048.issue: Separate evidence collection/time-window reconstruction from the impact interpretation; no requirement to recover unavailable records or assert confirmed exfiltration.
Review feasible evidence preservation alongside containment; no rigid order that leaves a public bucket exposed until exhaustive imaging finishes.

CYBER037.issue: Inspect success/outcome versus corroborating post-access behavior as distinct evidence; no mandatory list of all telemetry fields.
Check ordinal anchors and avoid requiring blanket blocking of every source or service shutdown.

DEC062.issue: Do not split every possible metadata field into a mandatory RIU; examples are alternative diagnostics within definition and period checks.
No universal rule that newer/official/larger is always correct; an explicitly deferred decision is valid.

DEC080.issue: Clarity and respectful delivery are separately assessable joint objectives; do not require one prescribed feedback script.
Cultural sensitivity must not become unsupported claims about whole national or ethnic groups.

DEC076.issue: An include/omit decision rule is sufficient; no fabricated cause, deadline or exhaustive incident-template fields required.
Check the boundary between useful uncertainty guidance and an unsolicited requirement to publish confidential internals.

DEC087.issue: Root-cause evidence and the intervention choice are distinct; do not require deploying every option.
Review ordinal partial credit: a substantive cause-response link can earn half; mentioning all four labels without a decision cannot.

DEC027.issue: Distinguish assessing training burden from the final tradeoff judgment; no mandatory weighted scoring formula or numerical payback period.
Check that compatibility examples remain alternatives rather than a compulsory exhaustive procurement checklist.

SYN053.issue: Withhold unconditional completion without assuming every administrative approval always blocks all definitions of completion.
Do not require a fabricated approver identity or assert that approval has been granted.

SYN020.issue: Keep each relational comparison together; do not separately score every number and duplicate its directional claim.
A balanced tradeoff meets the negative constraint without explicitly saying no universal winner; a refusal/nonanswer still scores 0.

SYN045.issue: Completed account disablement should be recognized in content but not counted again as a new instruction.
The note does not prescribe a precise device-review deadline; accept immediate assessment or an explicit follow-up path that does not ignore it.

SYN065.issue: A complete interpretation must distinguish outcome dimensions; do not require a formal utility function or assert the launch caused either change.

SYN077.issue: EN/BN/BN-CS all say rollback is tested then explicitly that testing failed; review the operational reading that passing readiness, rather than mere test execution, is required.
Failed-condition evidence and no-go conclusion are distinct; do not require an invented rollback repair procedure.

PROC092.issue: Accept any feasible alternative; do not require finding a new speaker when none is available.
Notification and update of shared meeting records are distinct; a single message/invite update may express both propositions.

PROC060.issue: Review conflict checking versus committed reservation/confirmation as distinct operational outcomes; no requirement for software locking syntax.
Change and cancellation are independently assessable lifecycle paths, not a mandatory platform feature list.

PROC026.issue: Distinguish a common argument/outline from final cross-section integration; do not double-count a mere instruction to use the outline.
Four students all need meaningful responsibility; exact equality of words or one section per person is not required.

PROC003.issue: A separate copy is valid even if the copy itself is editable; the prompt protects the original, not necessarily all derivative copies.
Do not impose exact file format, password or export settings; review whether accessibility is preserved by the selected method.

PROC037.issue: Input gathering and the resulting scheduling logic are distinct; no invented exact itinerary is required.
Review ordinal anchor and allow a valid conditional planning algorithm instead of requiring numeric times that the prompt does not provide.

TECH082.issue: A displayed numeric format is not proof of numeric storage; a small test is supporting, not a compulsory repair of the whole sheet.
Character contamination and locale/separator mismatch are distinct diagnostic routes; do not require all examples or assume a specific locale.

TECH050.issue: Resource-specific leak evidence and a cross-signal time series are distinct; the same memory metric alone cannot fully satisfy observability correlation.

Second-pass audit removed the broad integrative diagnosis RIU to avoid overlap with the specific cause-area checks. Validate prompt coverage without requiring a proven final cause or an extra generic synthesis unit.

TECH036.issue: Scope logic and data/parameter validation are separately assessable; do not mandate every WHERE/join/subquery example.
A test-only or non-destructive review path meets the conditional safety requirement; no obligation to execute a live transaction or restore backup now.

TECH066.issue: Physical compatibility and configured operating settings are distinct; do not assume any particular generation of RAM.
Safe handling is conditional on physical access; an evidence-only diagnostic path need not repeat irrelevant hardware disassembly warnings.
Diagnostic restraint should not become a compulsory assertion of one proven cause; accept appropriate module/slot or stability comparisons.

TECH096.issue: The cross-computer comparison should support a hardware-versus-host distinction; do not award an additional broad diagnostic-conclusion RIU for repeating this interpretation.
Application profiles can contain image settings; confirm the two units target application-specific behavior versus direct image controls without requiring duplicate resets.
